breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed treating the internal torque as a single algebraic sum over the full length. The generated specification correctly removes this erroneous instruction and instead specifies that the shaft is divided into two segments (0 to 800 mm and 800 to 1200 mm) with internal torque constructed for each segment based on equilibrium, matching the ground truth's piecewise constant approach.
